body: Fix prepare_multibranch_data.py: rebuild ordered_distilled after cap_distilled_columns() so per-type caps actually bind in the v4 sibling-grouped path (group_distilled_by_proximity consumes ordered_distilled, line ~2429). Discovery: every distilled cap incl. v13's global 600 and latdec's decimal=2600 has been cosmetic for v4-format training data. Load-bearing change — needs its own validation run (a v19-recipe rebuild + distribution diff) BEFORE any future retrain relies on caps. v27 works around it by enforcing masses in the blend CSV (build_v27_recall_distilled.py BASE_KEEP/MINED_KEEP).

Re-routed at spec close: load-bearing training-tooling fix needing its own validation rebuild + distribution diff — filed as memo .orbit/memos/2026-06-12-ordered-distilled-cap-bug.md for distillation.
